description: This file implements CANopen driver functions for Zephyr RTOS, including CAN message handling, filter management, error checking, and initialization routines.

methods.name: canopen_send_lock
methods.description: Locks the send mutex to ensure exclusive access during CAN message transmission.

methods.name: canopen_send_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the send mutex after CAN message transmission.

methods.name: canopen_emcy_lock
methods.description: Locks the emergency mutex.

methods.name: canopen_emcy_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the emergency mutex.

methods.name: canopen_od_lock
methods.description: Locks the object dictionary mutex.

methods.name: canopen_od_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the object dictionary mutex.

methods.name: canopen_detach_all_rx_filters
methods.description: Detaches all receive filters from the CAN module.

methods.name: canopen_rx_callback
methods.description: Callback function invoked upon receiving a CAN frame, dispatching to registered buffers.

methods.name: canopen_tx_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked after a CAN frame is transmitted, resubmitting work.

methods.name: canopen_tx_retry
methods.description: Retries sending queued CAN frames.

methods.name: CO_CANsetConfigurationMode
methods.description: Sets the CAN interface to configuration mode.

methods.name: CO_CANsetNormalMode
methods.description: Sets the CAN interface to normal operation mode.

methods.name: CO_CANmodule_init
methods.description: Initializes a CANopen CAN module with specified parameters.

methods.name: CO_CANmodule_disable
methods.description: Disables a CAN module and detaches filters.

methods.name: CO_CANrxMsg_readIdent
methods.description: Reads the identifier from a received CAN message.

methods.name: CO_CANrxBufferInit
methods.description: Initializes a receive buffer with specified ID, mask, and callback.

methods.name: CO_CANtxBufferInit
methods.description: Initializes a transmit buffer with specified parameters.

methods.name: CO_CANsend
methods.description: Sends a CAN message using the specified transmit buffer.

methods.name: CO_CANclearPendingSyncPDOs
methods.description: Clears pending synchronized PDOs in the transmit buffer.

methods.name: CO_CANverifyErrors
methods.description: Checks and reports CAN bus errors and states.
